contract.name: PAYSTACK_APPROVAL_PRODUCT_BOUNDARY
rules: AfriDigital-hub remains the primary Paystack-facing product
AfriDesign Studio is a separate developer-facing frontend
AfriDesign Studio does not replace AfriDigital-hub
Paystack approval-facing product identity must remain stable
Payment-facing UX and business purpose must not be changed implicitly by the new frontend
No deployment or payment-contract changes are authorized by this architecture decision
